name: Split Quote
description: A client review: the portrait fills the left 42%, and a tone panel on the right carries a large quotation mark, the italic quote, stars, the client's name and a detail line.
photoTip: Portrait photos work best; the frame is tall and narrow. Set the focus on the faces.

fields.label: Quote
fields.hint: Their words. Shrinks to fit; around 80 characters reads best, up to about 200.

fields.label: Detail
fields.hint: Optional: occasion, place or year, such as 'Newborn session · 2026'.

sample.quote: Every photo feels like a memory I didn't know I had.
sample.name: Maya & Jonah
